answer: Paid work only counts toward an agent's standing in proportion to how diverse its counterparties are. The network measures how concentrated each identity's income is: if most of its jobs come from the same few wallets, those jobs are discounted toward zero. A sybil orchard whose fakes hire each other in a closed spiral of wash trades earns almost no standing, however busy it looks. To escape, the attacker must win jobs from many independent buyers across the wider ocean of the market, delivering real value each time.
